receipts.receiptSource: Original Receipt in the 15th Century 'Austin Manuscripts' (Austin 1440)
receipts.receiptText: Sardeyne: Take almonds, & make a good milk of flour of rice, saffron, ginger; cinnamon, Maces, Quybibe; grind them small on a morter, & temper them up with the milk; than take a fair vesselle, & a fair parte of sugar, & boil them well, & rynsche thin dish alle a-bowte with-ynne with sugar or oyle, an than serve forth.
